timestamp_derivation: Written after the PRE-LIVE and Central deployments of the PR #202 corrections were read back and verified, and before the commit that introduces this receipt.
authorisation: Product-Owner mission of 2026-09-29: continue PR #202, correct every PRE-LIVE testing finding and complete the optional sign-in methods end to end; implementation, tests, migrations if required, PRE-LIVE and Central deployment, verification and governance synchronization authorised; merge NOT authorised.
delivered: Central activation: an appliance whose certificate Central revoked for reissue now reconciles by itself (scd submits a CSR over the signed HTTPS ingress, Central auto-issues on the activated appliance); Central names why an appliance is still activating (certificate_reissue / certificate / license) and offers the offline Activation package only when an unconsumed offline request exists.

Reachability: a 401/403 from Central after a recent success is reported as credential_refused ('Renewing its certificate') and triggers the reconcile, instead of 'Temporarily unreachable'; real faults are still reported.

Hotel Admin TLS check: validates the served chain against the unchanged root (Caddy rotates its 7-day intermediate); the page shows the reason ('INVALID: ...' / 'OK (renewal due: ...)') instead of the exit code. Root CA and trust roots untouched.

Module visibility: without a module the day-to-day Admin Console shows none of its concepts (Overview, Sign-in methods, Payment methods, package editor, Portal Settings strings and previews, sessions, usage, activity, allowed sites, client accounts, diagnostics); pages do not call module-owned APIs for an absent module; history and recovery stay reachable where records exist; edged refuses to switch on a sign-in method whose module is not licensed and deployed.

Optional sign-in methods: Email, SMS and WhatsApp one-time codes and Google, Facebook, Apple and Microsoft social sign-in, each offered only when licence, deployment ceiling (IAM-v2 OTP/SOCIAL), local switch and provider readiness allow; WhatsApp is its own channel and licence module (whatsapp_otp, migration 0099 plus owner script), Meta Cloud API and Twilio via approved authentication templates; secrets write-only and never logged.
verification: Go: license, control-plane api/licensing, data-plane edged, scd, portald, social, socialloader, whatsapp, notifyloader, licstate, modules, deployment, appliancecert. Admin Console vitest 54 files / 626 tests and tsc; Central console vitest 10 files / 143 tests. phase4-dark-check PASS, validate-migration-grant-durability PASS, FACTORY_CLEAN_BASELINE PASS through 0099. Live on PRE-LIVE: scd reissued its revoked certificate at startup and Central/appliance both report connected and activated; hotel-admin-cert-manager check OK; scripts/guest-access-e2e-test.sh 43/43 on the site's current licence (no optional module: Room sign-in refused as it must be). Central central-deploy.sh smoke PASS 8/8.
